question: In Box: Add the tag launch-ready to the file in the Marketing folder whose review task created by omar.haddad@northwind.example on June 12 asks to review the launch checklist.
final:
Done. I found the Marketing folder, checked the tasks on all 9 files, and identified the correct one:

**Q2 launch brief.pdf** (id: 8201) — task 8211: *"Please review the launch checklist before Friday"*, created by `omar.haddad@northwind.example` on **June 12, 2026**.

I ruled out the decoys: 8202 was created by a different user (Omar Haddadi), 8206 on June 13, and 8207 on June 9. The file had no existing tags, so I added **`launch-ready`** — confirmed in the API response (`"tags":["launch-ready"]`).
